jokes_2.webp: I told my suitcase there will be no vacation. Now I am dealing with emotional baggage.
Why did the coffee file a police report? It got mugged.
I only know 25 letters of the alphabet. I do not know Y.
Parallel lines have so much in common. Sad they will never meet.
I used to hate facial hair, but then it grew on me.
jokes_3.webp: What do you call fake spaghetti? An impasta.
I would tell you a construction joke, but I am still working on it.
My wallet is like an onion. Opening it makes me cry.
Why do not eggs tell jokes? They would crack each other up.
I am reading a book on anti-gravity. Impossible to put down.
jokes_4.webp: The early bird gets the worm, but the second mouse gets the cheese.
I named my dog Five Miles so I can say I walk Five Miles daily.
Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.
I do not trust stairs. They are always up to something.
What is orange and sounds like a parrot? A carrot.

poems_2.webp:
Stars do not fight the dark,
they simply choose to shine.

Rivers never rush the sea,
yet always find their way.

A quiet heart still hears
the music of the morning.

The smallest seed believes
in forests it has never seen.

Rain forgets the clouds,
the moment it meets the earth.
poems_3.webp:
Even broken roads
can lead to golden places.

The moon is proof that
broken things can glow.

Roots grow in silence,
before the flowers speak.

Every ending hides
a doorway to begin.

Winds carry no maps,
yet reach the farthest shore.
poems_4.webp:
Hope is a candle
that outlasts the storm.

Let your soul be soft
and your spirit unbreakable.

The sky never apologizes
for changing its colors.

Some flowers bloom
only for those who wait.

Be the calm
you keep searching for.

quotes_attitude_1.webp: I do not follow the crowd, I lead myself.
My vibe speaks before I do.
Built different, and proud of it.
I am not lucky, I am relentless.
quotes_attitude_2.webp: Class is permanent, hype is temporary.
I move in silence and let results talk.
quotes_attitude_3.webp: They watched me rise from where they left me.
My confidence is not for sale.
I bend rules, never my spine.
I am the plot, not the side character.
quotes_good_morning_night_1.webp: Good morning — a fresh page, write it well.
Rise with purpose, shine with grace.
Every sunrise is a second chance.
Good night — let the stars carry your worries.
Sleep well, tomorrow needs the best of you.
quotes_good_morning_night_2.webp: Morning coffee, evening calm, a full day lived.
Wake up grateful, sleep up peaceful.
May your morning be soft and your coffee strong.
Close your eyes, the day is safe now.
New day, new mercy, new mile.
quotes_good_morning_night_3.webp: Good night — rest is also progress.
Let the dawn remind you: you made it through.
Sunrise in your eyes, hope in your heart.
End the day kindly, you did enough.
quotes_krishna_gita_1.webp: Do your duty, leave the results to me. — Gita
The soul is neither born nor does it die.
Change is the law of the universe.
You have the right to work, not to its fruits.
Set your heart on the work, not the reward.
quotes_krishna_gita_2.webp: A calm mind is stronger than any weapon.
The one who has conquered the mind is at peace.
Perform your action free from attachment.
When meditation is mastered, the mind is still.
Whatever happened, happened for the good.
quotes_krishna_gita_3.webp: The wise grieve neither for the living nor the dead.
Let go of anxiety over what you cannot control.
Be steadfast in devotion, do your work.
The self is a friend to those who master it.
quotes_love_1.webp: You are my favorite hello and hardest goodbye.
In a room full of art, I would still stare at you.
Home is not a place, it is you.
I found forever in the way you smile.
You are the poem I never knew how to write.
quotes_love_2.webp: Loving you is the easiest thing I do.
Every love song makes sense now — it is you.
With you, even ordinary feels magical.
My heart is yours, no returns accepted.
You are the reason I believe in soft things.
quotes_love_3.webp: I choose you, today and every messy day after.
Your hand in mine, that is my safe place.
You are my calm in every storm.
Some souls just recognize each other. Ours did.
I love you more than yesterday, less than tomorrow.
quotes_love_4.webp: You are my favorite hello and hardest goodbye.
In a room full of art, I would still stare at you.
Home is not a place, it is you.
I found forever in the way you smile.
You are the poem I never knew how to write.
quotes_money_2.webp: Do not work for money, make money work.
Wealth is built in silence, not in noise.
Save like a pessimist, invest like an optimist.
Rich is not what you spend, it is what you keep.
quotes_money_3.webp: Every rupee saved is a soldier for your future.
The best investment is in yourself.
Broke is temporary, mindset is forever.
quotes_motivational_1.webp: Start where you are, use what you have.
Your only limit is the one you accept.
Dream big, start small, act now.
quotes_motivational_2.webp: One day or day one — you decide.
Hard work quietly beats talent that hides.
Be stronger than your best excuse.
quotes_motivational_3.webp: The comeback is always greater than the setback.
Show up, even when it is hard.
Success is rented, and rent is due daily.
You did not come this far to only come this far.
Winners focus on winning, losers on winners.
quotes_sad_1.webp: Some wounds never show, yet always ache.
I smile so the world does not ask.
The loudest silence is a heart that gave up.
Missing someone who is still here hurts most.
I am tired in a way sleep cannot fix.
quotes_sad_2.webp: Not every storm passes, some just stay quiet.
I lost myself trying to hold someone else.
Sometimes goodbye is the only honest word left.
Empty rooms remember the loudest laughs.
I was too much and never enough, all at once.
quotes_sad_3.webp: The heart breaks quietly, then all at once.
I keep the pieces, hoping they still fit.
Some nights the mind is the loudest room.
I am okay is the biggest lie I tell.
quotes_self_love_2.webp: You are allowed to be both a masterpiece and a work in progress.
Talk to yourself like someone you love.
You are enough, exactly as you are.
Your worth is not up for debate.
quotes_self_love_3.webp: Rest is not a reward, it is a right.
Be your own reason to smile.
You cannot pour from an empty cup — fill yours.
Fall in love with taking care of yourself.
You are your longest commitment. Honor it.
quotes_shayari_2.webp: Tumhari ek muskaan, meri poori duniya ban gayi.
Dil ke kisi kone mein, tum aaj bhi rehte ho.
Ishq mein hisaab nahi hota, bas ehsaas hota hai.
Tere naam se meri subah, tere zikr se meri shaam.
Mohabbat wo hai jo alfaazon se pare hoti hai.
quotes_shayari_3.webp: Tum mile to laga, zindagi mukammal ho gayi.
Meri har dua mein bas tera hi naam hai.
Tere bina ye dil bhi adhoora sa lagta hai.
Chand bhi sharma jaaye, aisi hai teri raunak.
Tumhe dekh kar hi mera din bann jaata hai.
quotes_sigma_1.webp: Lone wolves do not run in packs.
Master your emotions, master your life.
A calm man is a dangerous man.
quotes_sigma_2.webp: Comfort is the enemy of growth.
Be so quiet that your results scream.
The grind does not care how you feel.
quotes_sigma_3.webp: Focus on the goal, ignore the noise.
Weak men blame, strong men build.
Your peace is your power. Guard it.
Alone is where legends are made.
shayari_1.webp: Zindagi ki kitab mein, tum sabse haseen panna ho.
Kuch log dil mein rehte hain, kirayedaar nahi hote.
Wo aaye to lagta hai, mausam badal gaya.
Har raat ke baad ek nayi subah likhi hoti hai.
Dard bhi apna sa lagta hai, jab tumhara zikr ho.
shayari_2.webp: Ummeed ka daaman kabhi haath se mat chhodna.
Muskurana seekh liya, gham chhupana aa gaya.
Tere shehar se guzra to, saans thehar si gayi.
Waqt badalta hai, par kuch yaadein amar rehti hain.
Chahat mein sharton ki jagah nahi hoti.
shayari_3.webp: Aankhon mein sapne rakho, haath mein mehnat.
Jo apne hote hain, wo fasle nahi maante.
Khamoshi bhi bahut kuch keh jaati hai.
Manzil unhi ko milti hai jo raaston se darte nahi.
Dil se socho to har mushkil aasan lagti hai.

shayari_17.webp: Zindagi ki kitab mein, tum sabse haseen panna ho.

Dard bhi apna sa lagta hai, jab tumhara zikr ho.
